headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.quadratic_comparison
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π g : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
      Marked.Survivor.bind π K = π →
        0 ≤ ρ →
          Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
            Marked.Survivor.inner π g (Marked.Survivor.act K g) ≤
              ρ * Marked.Survivor.energy π g + (1 - ρ) * Marked.Survivor.mean π g ^ 2

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.killed_quadratic_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π u f : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
      Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
        0 ≤ ρ →
          ρ ≤ 1 →
            Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
              (∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) →
                Marked.Survivor.inner π u (Marked.Survivor.killed K f u) ≤
                  (ρ + (1 - ρ) * Marked.Survivor.mean π f) * Marked.Survivor.energy π u

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.killed_energy_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π u f : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
      Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
        Marked.Survivor.IsPSD π K →
          0 ≤ ρ →
            ρ ≤ 1 →
              Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
                (∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) →
                  Marked.Survivor.energy π (Marked.Survivor.killed K f u) ≤
                    (ρ + (1 - ρ) * Marked.Survivor.mean π f) ^ 2 * Marked.Survivor.energy π u

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.killed_survivor_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype X] (π f : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
    (∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ f x) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        Marked.Survivor.mass (Marked.Survivor.killedSurvivor π K f n) =
          Marked.Survivor.inner π (fun x => √(f x)) (Marked.Survivor.killedIter K f (fun x => √(f x)) n)

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.terminal_exhaustion_bound
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (ν : Y → ℝ) (s ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
      Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
        Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
          Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
            Marked.Survivor.IsPSD π K →
              (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
                0 ≤ ρ →
                  ρ ≤ 1 →
                    Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
                      ∀ (n : ℕ),
                        Marked.Survivor.mass (Marked.Survivor.killedSurvivor π K (Marked.Survivor.failure A) n) ≤
                          (1 - s) * (1 - (1 - ρ) * s) ^ n

headlines.name: Marked.Survivor.terminal_exhaustion_bound_positive_marks
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (π : X → ℝ) (K : X → X → ℝ) (A : X → Y → ℝ)
  (ν : Y → ℝ) (s ρ : ℝ),
  Marked.Survivor.IsProbability π →
    Marked.Survivor.IsProbability ν →
      Marked.Survivor.IsMarkov K →
        Marked.Survivor.IsTerminal A →
          Marked.Survivor.IsReversible π K →
            Marked.Survivor.IsPSD π K →
              (Marked.Survivor.bind π A = fun y => s * ν y) →
                0 ≤ ρ →
                  ρ ≤ 1 →
                    Marked.Survivor.CenteredL2Contraction π K ρ →
                      ∀ (R : ℕ),
                        0 < R →
                          Marked.Survivor.mass
                              (Marked.Survivor.killedSurvivor π K (Marked.Survivor.failure A) (R - 1)) ≤
                            (1 - s) * (1 - (1 - ρ) * s) ^ (R - 1)
